prior_exclusions.note: Prior pair-loop probes read data[i+1] twice syntactically. Their failure to unroll did not exclude the new single packed-byte temporary source class. Existing state arrays, direct macro expansions, packet-local reuse, volatile forms, helper functions and compiler-flag controls are recorded there and were not treated as a matching baseline.

primary_source_ancestry.scope: Declaration/reuse and nibble-loop skeleton only. The target unsigned routine has adjacent 16-bit coefficients, unsigned arithmetic, and no saturation, so this is not a claim that the historical function is identical.

comparison_method: All 752 original bytes through the next function boundary, including native alignment, are compared to every complete emitted candidate extent. All 172 candidates have zero relocations; no bytes are masked. Count unequal byte positions over the common extent plus any length difference. The first 74 bytes are the packet-copy prefix; the first 79 additionally contain the native five-byte header load. One backward branch is the retained packet-copy loop; extra backward branches show a retained decoder loop.
findings: A single packed-byte local changes an ordinary eight-pair loop from a 224-byte retained loop to a fully unrolled 688-byte decoder. ++i versus i+=1 produces identical complete bodies in the four-way causal control.
The causal fully unrolled body remains 655 byte positions different from the native 752-byte body; successful unrolling is not a native match.

The target has a 16-byte local frame and 28 MOV stores to DWORD ESP operands, fourteen each at displacements 40 and 44. These are predictor spill slots in the incoming-argument area, not evidence for additional local predictor-array storage.
Two-element predictor-array controls add eight local bytes and do not reproduce the native state-store pattern; these controls provide no reason to add storage to canonical source.
All twelve two-output-store sample-counter forms retain a decoder loop and span 224 to 256 bytes.

No native body was recovered. Canonical unsigned source, grouped function order, and all previously exact bodies are unchanged. No behavior claim is made for rejected source controls, and no reduced byte difference count is used as success.

groups.name: UnsignedSampleLoops
groups.scope: Sixteen individual-sample loops with four primary-SLIST-style nibble extraction forms, three induction forms, packet-local reuse, and 16/32-bit coefficients.

groups.name: UnsignedPointerPairs
groups.scope: Eight-pair loops loading a packed-byte temporary; ascending or countdown induction, indexed or advancing source/output pointers, packet-local reuse, and 16/32-bit coefficients.

groups.name: UnsignedUnrolled
groups.scope: Packed-byte pair loops with scalar versus two-element predictor state, packet-local reuse, four header/history initialization orders, and three packed-byte variable types.

groups.name: UnsignedHistoricalPairs
groups.scope: Packed-byte pair loops with both packet-local reuse directions, the recovered historical declaration order and unused locals, and header-first initialization.

groups.name: UnsignedCausal
groups.scope: Four-way causal control: canonical pair macro in an eight-pair loop, with/without one packed-byte local and ++i versus i+=1.

groups.name: UnsignedOutputCounters
groups.scope: Sixteen-sample output counter incremented by both output[i++] stores; for/while/do, separate packed-byte index versus index derived from i, and 16/32-bit coefficients.
